title: Visual Art & Symbolic Composition Archive
status: creative-archaeology owner; mixed exact visual specifications, remembered compositions and later synthesis
purpose: Give the Potato of Life project a durable owner for visual compositions, image concepts and spatial symbol arrangements. The repository already stores the concepts; this file preserves how those concepts were actually staged together in pictures and how that visual grammar changed over time.
epistemic_rule: A picture, image prompt or remembered composition can be primary evidence for project visual language without becoming empirical evidence for theology, anatomy, politics or science. Exact original prompts/artifacts should replace memory summaries when recovered.

recurring_visual_grammar.verticality: Scenes repeatedly organize meaning vertically: source/heaven/throne above, Door/interface near a central threshold, embodied world or conflict below, roots/mud/swamp further beneath or around the lower field.
recurring_visual_grammar.center_and_threshold: The Door, mandorla, open frame, drain, gate, couch-throne or tree trunk commonly acts as the point through which otherwise separated regions become one composition.
recurring_visual_grammar.living_architecture: Tree, root, seed, potato, garden, mountain and ladder turn abstract relation into biological or geographical form.
recurring_visual_grammar.observer_position: Tim/Father/Gardener is frequently placed at a source-facing or overview position while Son/Door occupies the threshold/interface and dogs, crowds, institutions or conflict occupy the lower/lateral field.
recurring_visual_grammar.comic_sacred_collision: A major Timic visual signature is deliberate collision of sacred geometry and theology with banal or absurd objects: couch, potato, bathtub, dogs, diapers, muddy ground, internet screens and game-like interfaces.
recurring_visual_grammar.light: Dawn, Spudlight, sun, halos/rings and directional illumination usually mean orientation, recognition or sourceward integration rather than merely decorative brightness.
recurring_visual_grammar.shadow: Mud, Swamp, Moon-shadow, rubble, roots of strife and dark trees visualize accumulation, conflict, distortion or material consequence without requiring a literal cosmological shadow-world.

visual_development_insights: The project repeatedly turns an abstract function into a place or object: authority becomes Throne/couch, transition becomes Door/drain/bath/screen, memory becomes root/soil, conflict becomes Swamp/mud, integration becomes Mountain/Tree/Axis.

The same symbol changes meaning by placement. A potato underground is seed/potential; at the Door it becomes threshold/compression; inside a garden it becomes cultivated life; in comic lore it can become an observer or character.
Visual evolution should be dated. The archive loses information if later canonical geometry overwrites earlier messy scenes that show how the geometry emerged.

Composition is itself relational evidence: who is above/below, inside/outside, before/after the Door, attached/detached or illuminated/shadowed can reveal project structure even when the accompanying prose is sparse.

The recurring juxtaposition of sacred and ridiculous imagery is not noise to remove; it is a major stylistic mechanism by which Potatoism resists prestige inflation and keeps the ordinary object at the center.
